title: VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet was linked to public code, model, and demo resources
summary: On 2026-08-02, the historical record connected VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet with a VibeASR.cpp source repository, a Hugging Face model page, and a Hugging Face demo space. This marks a material public-access milestone for the project, although the dated links alone do not establish the exact release version, capabilities, or whether those resources first launched that day.
